text: I
'll start by fetching the shipping schedule and checking inventory for the single
line item simultaneously.
I have

all the data I need. Let me work through the feasibility analysis.

The order requests a ship date of
2026-07-10 (Friday). The lead time is 3 days, meaning the order must be cut
no later than 3 days before ship day — today is Wednesday July 8, and July
10 is Friday, which is only 2 days away, so the lead
time requirement alone is not met (need to cut by July
7 at the latest for a July 10 ship). Beyond the lead-time issue, on
-hand inventory is only 200 units against the required 720, a shortfall of 520 units.
The next inbound receipt of 1,200 units lands on 2026-07-16 (Thursday), which is not a
ship day. The earliest ship day on or after July
16 that also satisfies the 3-day lead time needs to be identified using
a tool result. The ship days are Mon, Wed,
Fri. July 16 is a Thursday, so the next valid ship day after that
would be Friday July 17. Let me verify the lead-time cut-off:
3 days before July 17 is July 14, which is after today (July 8), so the lead time can be satisfied for a July 17
ship date. At that point, inventory available would be 200 on
hand + 1,200 inbound = 1,400 units, which comfortably covers the 720 needed.

issues.summary: On-hand inventory of 200 units is 520 units short of the 720 required, and the only inbound receipt (1,200 units on 2026-07-16) does not arrive until after the requested ship date of 2026-07-10.
The requested ship date of 2026-07-10 is only 2 calendar days from today (2026-07-08), which is less than the required 3-day processing lead time.

proposed_fix.description: The earliest feasible ship date is 2026-07-17 (Friday). By that date the inbound receipt of 1,200 units on 2026-07-16 will have landed, bringing total available inventory to 1,400 units (200 on hand + 1,200 inbound), which fully covers the required 720 units. July 17 is a configured ship day (Friday), and with today being July 8, the 3-day lead time requirement is satisfied. Recommend updating requested_ship_date to 2026-07-17.

verdict.explanation: Two compounding issues block the requested ship date of 2026-07-10. First, with only 200 units on hand against a requirement of 720, there is a 520-unit shortfall; the sole inbound receipt of 1,200 units does not arrive until 2026-07-16, six days after the requested ship date. Second, July 10 is only 2 days from today, violating the 3-day processing lead time. The earliest date that resolves both issues is 2026-07-17: it is a valid ship day (Friday), the inbound stock will have arrived the day prior giving 1,400 available units, and the cut-off date of July 14 is well within the future.
